page.overview:
Who is Hattori Gatano?

Hattori Gatano is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah.

Her Warder is Sleete, whom she bonded ten years before the Last Battle.

Sleete mentioned that Hattori doesn't have much influence in the Tower, suggesting that she may be relatively weak in the One Power.

Since Covarla Baldene obtained command in Dorlan because she was the strongest in that group of Aes Sedai, Hattori must have an One Power strength level of or less. She would not be able to Travel without linking.
